Changelog:
* 2026-04-27: Fixed LOTS of typos caused by OCR and added hyphens not present in the original texts when needed ("three-quarter view", "three-dimensional")

Some notes on this gallery:

- The English used in this gallery is extracted directly and as is from the original Korean (https://e-hentai.org/g/2866876/bc98353da1/) and Chinese (https://e-hentai.org/g/2867483/6c6b471377/) releases. I'm not a native speaker, and even though I can tell some of the grammar is a bit awkward, I believe it can be perfectly understood (also adapting every text would take a lifetime lmaaaao). The prologue is the only text translated from japanese, and it's been machine translated.

- I have used OCR technology to copy paste the texts to make the process faster. This can and WILL end up in some errors ("thc" instead of "the", "vv" instead of "w", commas instead of full stops, etc. I have checked each page several times, but after checking hundreds of pages, some errors are bound to remain. If you spot any of them, please let me know so I can fix them asap.

- The text position is mostly based on the japanese raw. Some paragraphs may be wider or narrower than the originals, but I tried to keep the same aesthetic. I kept the drawings themselves in place except for a few pages, where I've moved them to better fit the text.

- "If the already uploaded galleries include English texts why go through this much effort? Are you dumb?" Although that's true, the Korean and Chinese versions are composed by two different books and the uploaded galleries are just photos, not scans. The Japanese raw is objetively superior because it's a compilation of those two books made by the publisher themselves and the scan is way better, but on the other hand is the only version that didn't include English texts.

PS: If you are proficient in English and want to improve even one of these texts, please PM me on the forums. If you spot a typo, please let me know so I can fix it. I made this for myself while trying to learn to draw, but I'm sure it will be helpful for someone else :)
